1. Open Minecraft Settings.

2. Under General, turn ON “Allow WebSocket Connections”.

3. Turn OFF “Require Encrypted Websockets” and accept the warning.

4. Enter a world where cheats/commands are enabled.

5. Send this once in chat:
%1$s

6. When CraftLive says Minecraft is connected, setup is complete. Send this one command again after Minecraft is fully closed.

• CraftLive now automatically detects when your TikTok LIVE starts and switches to Active LIVE.
• If the stream is offline or the connection drops, the app retries automatically.
• Gifts, likes, follows and other enabled interactions are delivered to Minecraft more reliably.
• During an active LIVE, CraftLive automatically creates a shareable PNG showing the enabled interactions.
• A new transparent LIVE list can be placed over the game and dragged anywhere by its header.
